title: Skillet Jambalaya
description: One-skillet jambalaya with turkey sausage and chicken thighs, rice toasted in the pan and simmered covered in chicken broth.

ingredients.name: bell pepper
ingredients.note: optional flavor trick, cut into large chunks and removed before serving

steps.title: Brown sausage
steps.text: Heat a large skillet with a lid over medium-high heat. Add {sausage} and cook until browned. Remove and set aside.

steps.title: Brown chicken
steps.text: Add {thighs} to the same skillet and season with {cajun}, {paprika}, {grangarlic}, {granonion}, {pepper} and {cayenne}. Cook until lightly browned.

steps.title: Toast rice
steps.text: Add {rice} and stir for 1 to 2 minutes to lightly toast it.

steps.title: Add liquid
steps.text: Return the sausage to the skillet and add {broth}. Add the large chunks of {bellpepper} now if using.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 to 25 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Do not stir while it cooks, so the rice does not turn gummy.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Remove from the heat and leave covered for 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Remove the bell pepper pieces if used, and fluff gently with a fork.

notes: Feeds 3 generously with leftovers. This is a separate, simpler recipe from the Creole Sausage Jambalaya.
